Name: Crop-2-Ore Processor
Author: socialcoder
Description:
Convert crops into ore or coal! 

This mod is great for those that aren't a fan of the mine or would like to be able to get ore and coal without having to go to the mine. The [b]Crop-2-Ore Processor[/b] requires [b]50 Stone, 5 coal, and 100 Wood[/b] to build and is available immediately for crafting.
